description: Defines the configuration and state management classes for QUIC crypto client, including cached server states, session cache interface, and client configuration settings.

classes.name: QuicResumptionState
classes.description: Stores state information for QUIC connection resumption, including TLS session, transport parameters, application state, and token.

classes.name: SessionCache
classes.description: Interface for managing storage and retrieval of QuicResumptionState objects.

classes.name: QuicCryptoClientConfig
classes.description: Holds crypto configuration for a QUIC client, including cached server states, session cache, proof verifier, and various configuration options.

classes.name: QuicCryptoClientConfig::CachedState
classes.description: Contains the necessary state for performing a 0-RTT handshake with a server, including server config, proof, and expiration info.

classes.name: QuicCryptoClientConfig::ServerIdFilter
classes.description: Abstract class used to filter server IDs for partial cache deletion.

methods.name: QuicCryptoClientConfig::LookupOrCreate
methods.description: Returns a cached state for a given server ID, creating it if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: QuicCryptoClientConfig::ClearCachedStates
methods.description: Removes cached states matching a filter.

methods.name: QuicCryptoClientConfig::FillInchoateClientHello
methods.description: Creates a client hello message to elicit server info, optionally using cached data.

methods.name: QuicCryptoClientConfig::FillClientHello
methods.description: Creates a client hello message based on current configuration for a specific server.

methods.name: QuicCryptoClientConfig::ProcessRejection
methods.description: Processes a rejection message from server and updates cached info.

methods.name: QuicCryptoClientConfig::ProcessServerHello
methods.description: Processes server hello message, updates cache, and outputs negotiated parameters.

methods.name: QuicCryptoClientConfig::ProcessServerConfigUpdate
methods.description: Updates cached source address token and server config based on update message.
